order: install the full Open Sturmovik payload over the selected IL-2 directory
install exactly eleven desktop shortcuts without launching utilities

modCatalogPolicy.reason: Mission Mate expects MODS\STD for automatic mod import, while Open Sturmovik loads Files separately. Linking Files as MODS\STD would make the wrapper scan the same payload twice.

bombsightTable2.reason: Keep the first window visible on a single 1024x768 or larger display instead of reusing the source-machine desktop coordinate.

zipNav.installationPolicy: Create a directory junction inside the selected installation so ZipNav sees its bundled maps without copying them. Never replace an existing mods\mapmods directory.

manualRuntimeSetup: WeatherSet: edit only a disposable mission copy.
ZipNav: select the installation root, use the linked bundled maps directory and validate map scale before adding a new map.
JoyCtrl: edit only a backed-up conf.ini while the game is closed.
